finalText:
**Redis outage cascaded into a full outage.**

`[app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)` Redis connection dropped at `02:14:07`.
Cache fell back to direct store reads.
That caused miss storms and timeouts.
Queue depth climbed past its `500` max.
Redis reconnects kept failing, 12 attempts total.
Worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory` at `02:31:44` `[app.log:717](logs/app.log:717)`.
Supervisor then killed the process group, `[app.log:719](logs/app.log:719)`.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` was unreachable for 17 minutes.
